state.title: Webizen — The living world
state.statusText: 600 m catchment & 13 living species active (871 instances). Press 2 Walk, 3 Fly, R Rhizosphere X-Ray, E Inspect.

frame_timing.scope: Elapsed successful portal.tick CPU/submission call, not GPU execution duration; raw RAF intervals exclude benchmark-paused frames

mesh_workload.scope: Current camera-frustum-visible mesh index spans multiplied by their submitted instance counts. Excludes raster clipping, sky, water, projectors and additional depth/shadow passes. This is current submission state, not the older completed GPU timestamp sample.

gpu_pass_timing.method: Etalon GPU query timestamps at pass-range boundaries
gpu_pass_timing.scope: AO; cached cascaded shadows; queued picking; forward scene including sky/water; temporal/output postprocessing. Excludes CPU submission, presentation wait and timestamp readback.

selected_adapter.name: nvidia blackwell
selected_adapter.source: Actual adapter used to create this portal device; privacy-redacted fields remain empty

instances.transform_provider: QualiaDB / Etalon Hamilton quaternion matrix and native ABI inverse-transpose frames

colour_path.habitat_mesh: MAT1 factors plus hydrated PNG/JPEG/KTX2 via load_texture_encoded; scene colour is a neutral [1,1,1,1] multiplier
colour_path.native_field: EMF [alpha, mu, sigma] converted by spectrum-area (CIE CMF x SPD) to display RGBA
colour_path.sky: procedural sky pipeline, camera uniform, no mesh_instances storage

served_build_identity.identity_kind: served build identity; browser QA must compare served WASM bytes with this digest
